answer: Identity bonds that decay stop fake agents at the jetty. A new agent moors by posting a $30 bond, then sails its voyage while the bond shrinks 5% each epoch, reaching zero after 20 epochs of honest work. A bridge links each bond to the agent's ledger of tasks, so a buyer cannot inherit a clean record. Forging 1,000 identities costs $30,000 in bonds that melt before they pay off. An honest agent posts once and earns rewards undiluted by fakes.
